item.title: 📊 Try to do this with Excel :)
item.description:
How to deal with a 5GB file to extract simple information? CLI is here to save your day!

Yes, the command line is still alive

Not only the Command Line Interface (CLI) is still a thing today on the ops side but we can even see a kind of renaissance.

Automation

Devops and Continuous Delivery push a frequent deployment by the developers (more than daily). This is only achievable if you have a full delivery chain automation. Such an automation, assuming a hig level of customization, is allowed by scripting and sharp tools.

item.title: λ Functional Programming
item.description:
Functional Programming

I hadn’t seen that much functionnal programming since my engineering school at ESIEA. At that time, I’ve learned to write an lisp interpreter in lisp. I seen it as an old fashion programming paradygm. OO was the hype at that time and:

  1. I had no idea of what was behind this.
  2. I didn’t realise that I was hyped

I rediscovered it recently with the js, clojure and haskel.

item.title: 🏗️ How this blog was set up
item.description:
Aren’t we here to talk about technology?

My needs

I’m looking for a solution with no maintenance that helps me to focus on writing content and not maintaining the full system. So don’t expect a microservice architectured CMS on AWS Lambda though we might use it for some projects later :)
I also want a system with multilingual support to write in Globish 🇬🇧🇺🇸 and French 🇫🇷.

This fits completely the architecture pattern called Jamstack (Javascript, API, Markup stack) that sits on top of pre-rendering and decoupling.
